# Stefano D'Ambrosio — Portfolio

> Front End Developer building modern web experiences.

## About

Full-stack developer specializing in Astro, React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies. Based in Italy, working freelance.

## Projects

- **BigBenchApp** — Web application for tracking progress in the Big Bench project, built with Next.js and Supabase.
  - Demo: [big-bench-app.vercel.app](https://big-bench-app.vercel.app)
  - Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/Stedamb/BigBenchApp)

- **Da Lenin Barber Shop** — Website for a barber shop built with Astro.
  - Demo: [daleninbarbershop.it](https://www.daleninbarbershop.it)
  - Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/Stedamb/DaLeninBarberShop)

- **Video Portfolio** — Video portfolio built with Astro.
  - Demo: [video-journal.vercel.app](https://video-journal.vercel.app)
  - Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/Stedamb/Videomaker-portfolio/tree/dev)

## Tech Stack

Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Node.js, Next.js, Supabase
